sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: UPPER LOW CURRENTLY SITUATED OVER THE GREAT LAKES WILL ADVANCE VERY SLOWLY EWD FRIDAY. ATTENDANT OCCLUDED SURFACE LOW WILL REMAIN OVER SRN ONTARIO WHILE WEAK SECONDARY CYCLOGENESIS IS FORECAST ALONG THE ATLANTIC SEABOARD FRIDAY AFTERNOON IN ASSOCIATION WITH JET STREAK ROTATING THROUGH BASE OF THE UPPER LOW. TRAILING COLD FRONT WILL MOVE OFF THE ATLANTIC SEABOARD BY FRIDAY EVENING. THE BOUNDARY WILL EXTEND WWD AS A STATIONARY FRONT THROUGH THE TN VALLEY TO A SURFACE LOW IN WRN KS. DRYLINE WILL EXTEND SWD FROM THIS LOW THROUGH WRN PORTIONS OF THE SRN PLAINS. UPPER LOW OVER BRITISH COLUMBIA WILL ADVANCE SLOWLY EWD THROUGH THE NRN ROCKIES WITH AN IMPULSE ROTATING THROUGH THE SRN PERIPHERY OF THIS FEATURE AND INTO THE NRN HIGH PLAINS DURING THE AFTERNOON. A COLD FRONT WILL CONTINUE THROUGH ERN MT INTO THE WRN DAKOTAS WHERE IT WILL LIKELY STALL.

sections.title: NRN HIGH PLAINS AREA
sections.text: SELY LOW LEVEL FLOW EAST OF LEE TROUGH WILL MAINTAIN MID-UPPER 50S DEWPOINTS OVER THE HIGH PLAINS OF NEB AND DAKOTAS TODAY BENEATH STEEP LAPSE RATES CONTRIBUTING TO 1500-2000 J/KG MLCAPE AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER WARMS. STORMS WILL LIKELY DEVELOP OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF WY AND CO THIS AFTERNOON WITHIN ZONE OF DEEPER BACKGROUND ASCENT ATTENDING IMPULSE MOVING THROUGH NRN ROCKIES. 40-50 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR WILL SUPPORT SUPERCELLS...BUT STORMS MAY EVENTUALLY CONGEAL INTO AN MCS CLUSTER AS THEY DEVELOP EWD INTO THE HIGH PLAINS DURING THE EVENING. ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND WILL BE THE MAIN THREATS BEFORE ACTIVITY WEAKENS LATER FRIDAY NIGHT.

sections.title: CNTRL PLAINS THROUGH THE MID-LOWER MS VALLEY
sections.text: AXIS OF UPPER 50S TO UPPER 60S DEWPOINTS WILL PERSIST IN VICINITY OF STALLED BOUNDARY FROM KS INTO THE MID-LOWER MS VALLEY FRIDAY WITH THE RICHER MOISTURE CONFINED TO THE MS VALLEY AREA. A WARM EML WITH 12-14C 700 MB TEMPERATURES WILL ADVECT EWD THROUGH KS AND OK EFFECTIVELY CAPPING THIS REGION. GIVEN PRESENCE OF STRONG CAP AND SHORTWAVE RIDGING ALOFT...FRONTAL CONVERGENCE WILL LIKELY REMAIN TOO SHALLOW FOR STORM INITIATION OVER MOST OF KS DURING THE DAY. AN EXCEPTION MAY BE ACROSS WRN KS IN VICINITY OF TRIPLE POINT WHERE DEEPER MIXING MAY CONTRIBUTE TO HIGH BASED STORMS. OTHER STORMS MAY ALSO DEVELOP FARTHER EAST FROM SERN KS INTO THE LOWER-MID MS VALLEY WHERE THE CAP SHOULD BE WEAKER. ANY STORMS THAT DO MANAGE TO DEVELOP WILL BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND AND HAIL GIVEN FAVORABLE THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT AND 30-40 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR. OTHERWISE...ELEVATED STORMS WILL BECOME PROBABLE OVERNIGHT WITHIN DEVELOPING WARM ADVECTION ZONE FROM NERN KS INTO ERN NEB...IA AND MO WITH A THREAT FOR ISOLATED HAIL AND GUSTY WINDS.

sections.title: ERN NC THROUGH MID ATLANTIC SEABOARD AND NRN STATES
sections.text: DIABATIC WARMING OF THE MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER WILL CONTRIBUTE TO DESTABILIZATION OF THE PRE-FRONTAL WARM SECTOR FROM THE CAROLINAS INTO MID ATLANTIC AND A PORTION OF NERN STATES. HOWEVER...WEAK MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES SHOULD LIMIT MLCAPE TO GENERALLY AOB 1500 J/KG. BAROTROPIC NATURE OF UPPER LOW WILL LIMIT VERTICAL SHEAR TO GENERALLY AOB 35 KT SUPPORTIVE OF MULTICELLS AND MARGINAL SUPERCELL STRUCTURES. PRIMARY THREAT WILL BE ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND. SEVERE THREAT SHOULD RAPIDLY DIMINISH FRIDAY EVENING. ..DIAL/LEITMAN.. 06/24/2011

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: SRN ONT UPR LOW WILL DRIFT SLOWLY E THIS PERIOD AS UPSTREAM LOW EDGES E FROM SRN BC TO SRN AB...AND BROAD RIDGE BUILDS E FROM THE SRN RCKYS ACROSS THE SRN PLNS. AT THE SFC...OCCLUDED LOW WITH ERN SYSTEM SHOULD REMAIN OVER SRN ONT THROUGH THE PERIOD AS WEAK SECONDARY CYCLOGENESIS OCCURS OVER THE MID ATLANTIC REGION IN RESPONSE TO VORT LOBE NOW OVER IL/IND. THE COLD FRONT TRAILING SW FROM THE LOW SHOULD MOVE OFF THE MID ATLANTIC CST TONIGHT...WITH THE WRN PART OF THE BOUNDARY CONTINUING AS A STNRY FRONT ACROSS THE TN VLY INTO A STNRY LOW OVER WRN KS. A DRYLINE WILL EXTEND S FROM THE KS LOW ACROSS THE SRN HI PLNS. IN THE WEST...AN IMPULSE NOW ROUNDING THE SRN FRINGE OF THE BC LOW SHOULD REACH THE NRN RCKYS/NRN HI PLNS LATE THIS AFTN/EVE. IN THE MEANTIME...WEAK COLD FRONT NOW IN MT EXPECTED TO SETTLE SLOWLY E/SE INTO THE WRN DAKOTAS AND WY...WHERE IT LIKELY WILL STALL AND BECOME INDISTINGUISHABLE FROM LEE TROUGH NOW OVER REGION.

sections.title: NRN/CNTRL HI PLNS THIS AFTN INTO TNGT
sections.text: SELY LOW LVL FLOW WILL MAINTAIN MID/UPR 50S DEWPOINTS E/SE OF LEE TROUGH/COLD FRONT OVER THE NRN/CNTRL HI PLNS TODAY BENEATH EML ON NRN FRINGE OF UPR RIDGE. WITH SFC HEATING...SETUP SHOULD YIELD 1500-2000 J/KG SBCAPE. TSTMS LIKELY WILL FORM THIS AFTN OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF WY/NRN CO...AND POSSIBLY OVER THE BLACK HILLS AND/OR ALONG LEE TROUGH...IN ZONE OF MODEST ASCENT ACCOMPANYING AFOREMENTIONED UPR IMPULSE. 40-50 KT W TO WNWLY DEEP SHEAR SHOULD SUPPORT SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL/DMGG WIND...WITH THE STORMS EVOLVING INTO ONE OR TWO MCSS THAT CONTINUE E/ESE TOWARD THE LWR PLNS THIS EVE. THE SVR THREAT SHOULD DIMINISH LATER TNGT.

sections.title: CNTRL PLNS TO MID/LWR MS VLY
sections.text: AN AXIS OF UPR 50S TO UPR 60S DEWPOINTS WILL PERSIST INVOF STALLED FRONT FROM KS ESE INTO THE MID-LWR MS VLY...WITH THE RICHEST MOISTURE CONFINED TO THE MS VLY. AN EML WITH 12-14C 700 MB TEMPS WILL MOVE EWD ACROSS KS/OK TODAY. COMBINATION OF EML CAP AND SHORTWAVE RIDGING ALOFT SHOULD PROHIBIT STORM DEVELOPMENT ALONG MOST OF THE KS AND OK PORTIONS OF FRONT THROUGH THE DAY. AN EXCEPTION MAY BE OVER WRN KS...WHERE DEEP MIXING MAY SUPPORT ISOLD HIGH-BASED STORMS NEAR THE TRIPLE POINT. OTHER STORMS MAY FORM ON THE FRONT FARTHER E...FROM SE KS INTO THE LWR-MID MS VLYS ...WHERE CAP SHOULD BE WEAKER. ANY STORMS THAT DO FORM WILL BE CAPABLE OF LOCALLY DMGG WIND AND HAIL GIVEN DEGREE OF INSTABILITY /SBCAPE TO 3500 J PER KG/ AND 30-40 KT WNWLY DEEP SHEAR. ELEVATED STORMS APPEAR PROBABLE TNGT N AND E OF FRONT...IN DEVELOPING ZONE OF WAA ON NERN FRINGE OF EXPANDING UPR RIDGE. THESE COULD YIELD POCKETS OF SVR HAIL AND LOCALLY DMGG WIND FROM NERN KS INTO ERN NEB...IA AND MO.

sections.title: ERN NC NWD THROUGH MID ATLANTIC/NERN STATES THIS AFTN
sections.text: SFC HEATING OF THE MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER WILL SUPPORT MODEST DESTABILIZATION OF WARM SECTOR OVER THE MID ATLANTIC AND PORTIONS OF UPSTATE NY TODAY. HOWEVER...WEAK MID LVL LAPSE RATES SHOULD KEEP AFTN SBCAPE GENERALLY AOB 1500 J/KG. COMBINATION OF SFC HEATING...ASCENT WITH IL/IND VORT...AND 30-35 KT WSWLY DEEP SHEAR SHOULD SUPPORT DEVELOPMENT OF SCTD MULTICELLS/MULTICELL CLUSTERS AND PERHAPS A FEW MARGINAL SUPERCELLS BY MID AFTN. THESE COULD YIELD ISOLD DMGG WIND AND MARGINALLY SVR HAIL. THE SVR THREAT SHOULD RAPIDLY DIMINISH THIS EVE. ..CORFIDI/GRAMS.. 06/24/2011

sections.title: UPSTATE NY/SWRN NEW ENGLAND INTO ERN NC
sections.text: VORTICITY MAXIMUM OVER IND/OH AS OF MID MORNING WILL TRANSLATE EWD TO OFF THE MID ATLANTIC COAST BY 25/12Z. DCVA IN ADVANCE OF THIS FEATURE COUPLED WITH CONVERGENCE ALONG EWD-PROGRESSING COLD FRONT WILL SERVE TO FOCUS SURFACE-BASED TSTM DEVELOPMENT THIS AFTERNOON. DESPITE THE TENDENCY FOR SLIGHT WARMING ALOFT...DAYTIME HEATING AND A MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER WITHIN PRE-FRONTAL WARM SECTOR WILL YIELD A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AND WEAKLY CAPPED ENVIRONMENT WITH MLCAPE APPROACHING 1500 J/KG. THIS INSTABILITY AXIS WILL COINCIDE WITH A BELT OF 40-45 KT WSWLY FLOW AT 500 MB...RESULTING IN SUFFICIENT /35-40 KT/ DEEP-LAYER SHEAR FOR ORGANIZED MULTICELL AND SOME SUPERCELL STRUCTURES CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL THROUGH THIS EVENING. FOR ADDITIONAL NEAR-TERM GUIDANCE ON NRN HALF OF REGION...SEE MCD 1372.

sections.title: NRN/CNTRL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: 12Z UPPER-AIR ANALYSIS SHOWS A MIDLEVEL THERMAL TROUGH FROM THE NRN ROCKIES INTO GREAT BASIN WHICH APPEARS TO BE ASSOCIATED WITH VORTICITY MAXIMA OVER ERN WA AND SRN ID. THESE FEATURES WILL PROGRESS EWD TODAY WITHIN PREVAILING WSWLY FLOW REGIME. DOWNSTREAM...A LEE LOW OVER WRN KS COUPLED WITH INVERTED/LEE TROUGH NWD THROUGH THE WRN DAKOTAS WILL MAINTAIN A LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE AXIS BENEATH THE NRN EDGE OF THE EML...RESULTING IN MODERATE AFTERNOON INSTABILITY WITH MLCAPE OF 1500-3000 J/KG. WEAK HEIGHT FALLS/DYNAMIC FORCING FOR ASCENT ATTENDANT TO ABOVE-MENTIONED IMPULSES WILL FOSTER SCATTERED TSTMS THIS AFTERNOON ALONG FAVORED TERRAIN AND INVERTED/LEE TROUGH. ELY/NELY LOW-LEVEL FLOW VEERING TO WSWLY IN THE MIDLEVELS WILL RESULT IN 40-50+ KT OF DEEP WLY SHEAR WHICH WILL SUPPORT SUPERCELL DEVELOPMENT. THE ABSENCE OF STRONGER LOW-LEVEL SHEAR WILL PRECLUDE A MORE ROBUST TORNADO THREAT. HOWEVER...LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE LIKELY WITH THE STORMS AS THEY MOVE/DEVELOP EWD/SEWD LATE THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT.

sections.title: MID MO INTO LOWER OH VALLEYS
sections.text: STRENGTHENING WAA/ISENTROPIC ASCENT AT THE TERMINUS OF A 50+ KT NOCTURNAL LLJ WILL SERVE TO FOCUS A BAND OF ELEVATED TSTMS OVERNIGHT ALONG THE ERN EDGE OF THE CAP WHERE MUCAPE WILL APPROACH 2000-3000 J/KG. GIVEN THE PRESENCE OF 40-45 KT OF CLOUD-BEARING SHEAR...ENVIRONMENT WILL BE SUPPORTIVE OF SEVERE STORMS CAPABLE OF HAIL AND PERHAPS DAMAGING WIND GUSTS.

sections.title: GULF COAST STATES
sections.text: DESPITE POOR MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES /REF. 12Z REGIONAL SOUNDINGS/...DAYTIME HEATING AND A MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER WILL YIELD AFTERNOON MLCAPE VALUES OF 1500-2500 J/KG. THE INFLUENCE OF WEAK MIDLEVEL IMPULSE TRANSLATING SEWD THROUGH THE LOWER MS VALLEY WILL CONTRIBUTE TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF SCATTERED STRONG TSTMS THIS AFTERNOON WITHIN PRE-FRONTAL WARM SECTOR. REGION WILL REMAIN DISPLACED WELL TO THE S OF STRONGER MIDLEVEL FLOW FIELD...RESULTING IN WEAK VERTICAL SHEAR. NONETHELESS THE PRESENCE OF STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND POTENTIAL FOR DOWNDRAFT ENHANCEMENT DUE TO WATER LOADING WILL RESULT IN ISOLATED OCCURRENCES OF DAMAGING WIND GUSTS INTO THIS EVENING. ..MEAD/COHEN.. 06/24/2011

sections.title: PORTIONS OF THE NORTHEAST AND MID-ATLANTIC SWD TO NC
sections.text: BROKEN BAND OF STORMS CONTINUES TO DEVELOP FROM THE ERN FRINGE OF LAKE ONTARIO AND ADJACENT UPSTATE NY SWD INTO NERN NC INVOF THE SURFACE COLD FRONT...WHILE SCATTERED/WEAKER CONVECTION IS ONGOING ACROSS THE LOWER GREAT LAKES AND UPPER OH VALLEY REGION. STORMS FROM SERN NY SWD INTO NC ARE OCCURRING IN A REGION OF MODERATE INSTABILITY AND SUFFICIENT DEEP-LAYER WIND FIELD TO SUPPORT A CONTINUATION OF THE SLIGHT RISK FORECAST INTO THIS EVENING. PRIMARY THREAT REMAINS LOCALLY DAMAGING GUSTS...THOUGH HAIL REACHING SEVERE LIMITS WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE WITH A FEW STRONGER CELLS.

sections.title: NRN AND CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: STORMS CONTINUE TO SLOWLY DEVELOP ACROSS PARTS OF WY AND ADJACENT NERN CO...AND SHOULD SPREAD EWD WITH TIME INTO THE DESTABILIZING AIRMASS ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS. THREATS FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL WILL ACCOMPANY STRONGER STORMS AS THEY EVOLVE THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING. FOR ADDITION SHORT-TERM INFORMATION...PLEASE REFER TO SPC SWOMCD #1375.

sections.title: MID MO VALLEY SEWD INTO NRN PORTIONS OF THE GULF COAST STATES
sections.text: BIGGEST CHANGE TO THE CURRENT FORECAST IS THE ADDITION OF SLIGHT RISK /15% HAIL AND WIND PROBABILITY/ ACROSS NRN PORTIONS OF THE GULF COAST STATES AND INTO SRN TN AND THE WRN CAROLINAS. A BAND OF STRONG/LOCALLY SEVERE STORMS HAS DEVELOPED ACROSS THIS REGION AHEAD OF A REMNANT MCV NOW CROSSING THE MID MS/TN VALLEY REGION. STORMS ARE INCREASING WITHIN THE VERY UNSTABLE AIRMASS WHICH HAS DEVELOPED ACROSS THIS REGION...WITH STEERING FLOW EXPECTED TO CARRY THE CONVECTION ESEWD/SEWD WITH TIME. WHILE MAGNITUDE OF THE FLOW FIELD IS NOT PARTICULARLY STRONG...DEGREE OF INSTABILITY IS SUFFICIENT GIVEN THE AMBIENT FLOW FIELD TO SUPPORT A MORE WIDESPREAD SEVERE EVENT THAN INITIALLY ANTICIPATED. ..GOSS.. 06/24/2011 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1112 AM CDT FRI JUN 24 2011/

sections.title: CNTRL AND NRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: STORMS HAVE EVOLVED INTO A COUPLE OF MCS CLUSTERS ACROSS WRN SD AND WRN NEB. ACTIVITY WILL CONTINUE EWD THROUGH THE MODERATELY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT INTO MID EVENING WHERE WLY EFFECTIVE SHEAR IN EXCESS OF 50 KT AND FAVORABLE STORM RELATIVE INFLOW WILL HELP TO MAINTAIN STORMS. PRIMARY THREATS WILL REMAIN ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND AND LARGE HAIL. THE MCSS SHOULD BEGIN TO WEAKEN TOWARD LATE EVENING AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER STABILIZES...CONVECTIVE INHIBITION INCREASES AND THE STORMS APPROACH THE ERN EDGE OF THE STRONGER INSTABILITY.

sections.title: ERN NEB THROUGH MID MS VALLEY
sections.text: RESERVOIR OF MODERATE MUCAPE REMAINS FROM ERN NEB SEWD THROUGH NERN KS...MO INTO NRN AR. LLJ WILL STRENGTHEN THIS EVENING AND AUGMENT WARM ADVECTION AND ISENTROPIC LIFT NORTH OF QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT THAT CURRENTLY EXTENDS FROM SRN KS SEWD THROUGH CNTRL AR. WHILE SURFACE BASED STORM DEVELOPMENT APPEARS INCREASINGLY UNLIKELY AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER STABILIZES...THE POTENTIAL FOR ELEVATED STORMS TO DEVELOP WILL PERSIST INTO THE OVERNIGHT. LATEST VISIBLE IMAGERY SHOWS A BAND OF MID LEVEL CONVECTION ALREADY DEVELOPING FROM EXTREME ERN KS INTO SWRN MO...AND THIS ACTIVITY COULD INTENSIFY FURTHER DURING THE OVERNIGHT. STEEP LAPSE RATES...MODERATE INSTABILITY AND 35-40 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR WILL SUPPORT A THREAT OF ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND.

sections.title: SERN STATES
sections.text: LINE OF MULTICELL STORMS FROM SC SWWD THROUGH SERN MS WILL POSE A THREAT FOR MAINLY ISOLATED STRONG WIND GUSTS THROUGH ABOUT 02-03Z. BRIEF INTENSIFICATION MAY OCCUR OVER S-CNTRL AL AND SERN MS AS THIS ACTIVITY MERGES WITH OUTFLOW FROM STORMS FARTHER SOUTH. HOWEVER...OVERALL TREND SHOULD BE FOR STORMS TO WEAKEN WITH THE ONSET OF NOCTURNAL COOLING.

sections.title: MID ATLANTIC THROUGH NERN STATES
sections.text: WIDELY SCATTERED STORMS DEVELOPING ALONG AHEAD OF COLD FRONT CONTINUES FROM ERN NC NWD INTO THE NERN STATES. A THREAT FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND MAY PERSIST INTO THE MID EVENING...MAINLY ACROSS NC...BUT OVERALL TREND SHOULD BE FOR STORMS TO UNDERGO GRADUAL WEAKENING. ..DIAL.. 06/25/2011
